messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-04-10] standup/ember/2025-04-10: Reminder: the authentication gateway is owned by the Ember team.
- [2025-07-01] handover/2025-07-01-auth-gateway: Quick one: the auth gateway belongs to team Cinder starting today. Thanks to the Ember team for running it until now.
- [2025-01-20] standup/ember/2025-01-20-2: The authentication gateway lives with team Ember.
- [2025-11-10] standup/ember/2025-11-10: Heads-up from team Ember: the authentication gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.
- [2025-04-14] standup/ember/2025-04-14: Auth-gateway deploy window: on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC.
- [2025-03-11] standup/ember/2025-03-11: Policy: every the auth gateway change requires two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off.
- [2025-01-20] standup/ember/2025-01-20: Team Ember owns the job scheduler.
- [2025-07-18] handover/2025-07-18-auth-gateway-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-07-01: auth-gateway went to team Boreal, not the Cinder team. Cinder never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-07-03] handover/2025-07-03-reporting-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-06-25: reporting went to Boreal, not Ember. Team Ember never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-11-17] standup/ember/2025-11-17: Team Ember saw that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump; not their service, so they flagged it. The weekly architecture review is run by Oskar.
- [2025-06-25] handover/2025-06-25-reporting: Ownership change: the reports pipeline now sits with team Ember. The Dune team no longer owns it.
- [2025-03-14] standup/atlas/2025-03-14: Dependency map update: the ledger needs the auth gateway (service tokens).
- [2025-01-10] standup/ember/2025-01-10: Oskar is the only engineer on team Ember for now.
- [2025-03-11] standup/ember/2025-03-11-2: Observation from team Ember: after the cache change, the webhooks service's memory use grew steadily for a week. Team Ember now does pairing on every production change.
- [2026-01-27] standup/boreal/2026-01-27: Auth-gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour. Rationale: the security audit flagged long-lived tokens.
- [2025-09-09] handover/2025-09-09-webhooks: The Ember team handed the webhook dispatcher to team Atlas today; Oskar wrote up the handover doc for Priya.
- [2025-05-28] standup/ember/2025-05-28: Observation from Ember: after the cache change, Ledger's memory use grew steadily for a week. Reminder: Oskar Lind is on call for team Ember this cycle.
- [2025-04-23] standup/ember/2025-04-23: The Ember team runs its planning on Fridays.
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08: For the record, Ledger is owned by team Atlas.
- [2025-04-11] handover/2025-04-11-webhooks: Quick one: webhooks belongs to team Ember starting today. Thanks to Boreal for running it until now.
- [2026-05-27] standup/ember/2026-05-27: Heads-up from team Ember: notifier's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.
- [2025-01-13] standup/ember/2025-01-13: First on-call rotation for the Ember team goes to Oskar.
- [2026-03-17] standup/cinder/2026-03-17: Reminder: notifier is owned by team Cinder.
- [2026-01-23] standup/ember/2026-01-23: Team Ember on-call swapped this morning. Diego carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2026-05-13] standup/ember/2026-05-13: Diego has the Ember pager this cycle, taking over from Oskar.
- [2026-03-16] standup/ember/2026-03-16: Oskar has the Ember pager this cycle, taking over from Diego Alvarez. Ember noticed that search-indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2025-07-09] incident-review/INC-2025-017: Incident review INC-2025-017. Auth-gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-07-06. Root cause: an expired intermediate certificate. Decision: certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead, because an expired intermediate certificate took logins down in INC-2025-017.
- [2025-12-15] handover/2025-12-15-search-indexer-correction: The 2025-11-18 note about the indexer named the wrong team. The Dune team took it over on that date; the Ember team did not.
- [2025-11-05] standup/ember/2025-11-05: Heads-up from Ember: notifier's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.
- [2026-04-17] standup/cinder/2026-04-17: Observation from the Cinder team: after the runtime upgrade, the authentication gateway's cold start time tripled.
- [2026-04-29] standup/ember/2026-04-29: Ember noticed that the resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09: The event bus is a the Boreal team service. The Boreal team owns notifier.

Question: Which team owned auth-gateway before Ember?

message.reasoning:
The question asks: which team owned auth-gateway before Ember?

Timeline:
- 2025-04-10: auth gateway owned by Ember team
- 2025-07-01: handover to Cinder
- 2025-07-18: correction — auth-gateway went to Boreal, not Cinder
- Also 2025-04-11: webhooks belongs to team Ember starting today; thanks to Boreal for running it until now. But that's webhooks, not auth-gateway.

So before Ember owned auth-gateway, who owned it? The handover of 2025-04-11 says "webhooks belongs to team Ember... Thanks to Boreal for running it until now" — that's webhooks. For auth-gateway, Ember owned it as of 2025-04-10 and 2025-01-20. There's no entry saying who owned auth-gateway before Ember.

The 2025-07-18 correction says auth-gateway went to Boreal (after Ember). But that's after Ember, not before.

So the memory does not contain who owned auth-gateway before Ember. Answer: I don't know.
